description: For the 8 paired tools (herdr hunk jjui jujutsu kew television tuicr yt-dlp): fold settings/programs/<tool>.nix into the options module as mkDefault values. Move self-gating tool modules to home-modules/programs/, auto-discovered overlay-style (ADR 0003); infra modules + helpers stay listed. Per-feature package lists move to home-modules/content/<feature>.nix (+ base.nix). Move caveman/gh-dash/cloudshell wiring out of home-modules/default.nix into their modules. Update CLAUDE.md section 5 + ARCHITECTURE.md with the split rule. No registry guard.
title: One module per tool; auto-discover home-modules/programs
